title: Regional Price Index: Multi-Channel Digital Subscription Prices by Country (2026.11)
description: Local list prices of 25 digital subscriptions, games and devices (37 plan tiers) across 18 storefronts and four checkout channels (iOS App Store, Google Play, direct web, Steam), with FX-converted USD, tax- and gift-card-adjusted landed cost, IMF PPP and work-hour affordability, payment friction and a four-tier verification flag. Every row was observed on an official storefront or vendor page within 30 days of the snapshot; storefronts not yet observed are omitted, never estimated. Snapshot 2026.11.01.
